question: Find the length of a transverse common tangent of the two circles whose radii are 3.5 cm, 4.5 cm and the distance between their centres is 10 cm.
solution:
Given:

The distance between their centres is 10 cm

Radii are 3.5 cm are 4.5 cm.

Concept used:

The length of a transverse common tangent of the two circles whose radii are r₁ and r₂ respectively and the distance between their centres is d = sqrt {d² - (r₁ + r₂)²}

Calculation:

Now, the length of the transverse common tangent of the two circles

⇒ sqrt {10² - (3.5 + 4.5)²}

⇒ sqrt {10² - 8²}

⇒ 6 cm

**∴ The length of the transverse common tangent of the two circles is 6 cm.**
